dedupe_keys.name: antwerp precipitation open water streams and sewer system sensor data

description: The CUTLER project publishes historical Antwerp sensor data for 2018–2020. Zenodo supplies an events CSV free under CC BY 4.0. The description identifies six open-stream level sensors, four rain gauges and three sewer-level sensors distributed across the city. These readings were used to examine garden-street interventions and can calibrate urban-drainage and surface-water simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this combined Antwerp sensor series. Coverage is the listed thirteen instruments and the stated years, not all rainfall or pipe assets in Antwerp. The sensor identifiers are documented, but observation cadence, clock handling and missing-data policy need checking. A garden-street dashboard use does not establish causal effects of an intervention. No CSV was downloaded or rainfall-runoff relationship fitted.
